title: Music-to-Environment (MTE) is an experimental AI/Unreal Engine project that generates playable game environments directly from music. (OPEN-SOURCE TOOL)
author: Early_Border8562
selftext:
The system analyzes musical features such as tempo, intensity, and spectral dynamics, then maps them to environmental structure, lighting, atmosphere, and spatial composition in real time. Instead of manually designing levels, the music serves as the blueprint. Calm passages produce open, minimal spaces; aggressive or dense sections generate tighter geometry, harsher lighting, and increased environmental pressure.

The goal is to explore how audio can drive level design, pacing, and player emotion, blurring the line between soundtrack and worldbuilding. This project sits at the intersection of procedural generation, multimodal AI, and game design, and serves as a foundation for future work in adaptive worlds and audio-driven gameplay systems.

Please let me know if you have any questions, or feel free to give feedback. I would love for everyone to combine this with boss battles. With the rise of generative AI, game development for indie devs has gotten much easier. Use MusicGPT to generate your own type of music. I have generated Elden Ring-style boss music, and I feel this is a great use for this to make more dynamic boss battles!

I still have to update some parts, but it's an ongoing project. Feel free to contribute. It's in its bare minimum state in this build, but it can be improved further. The end goal is to be able to generate entire environments (foliage, objects, enemies, etc.) just based on the music/soundtrack!
